.depot/workflows/depot-cache-auth-probe..text:
name: depot-cache-auth-probe
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
jobs:
  identity:
    runs-on: depot-ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c
        with:
          # Freeze the experiment bootstrap and avoid release-discovery API calls.
          version: 2026.10.9
          install: false
          cache: false
      - run: mise install node
      - name: Inspect job identity and conditionally probe tiny Cache roundtrip
        id: probe
        working-directory: .depot/probe/cache-auth
        run: mise run //.depot/probe/cache-auth:observe
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: depot-cache-job-identity
          path: ${{ steps.probe.outputs.evidence-path }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
